docs.question: What percentage of all docks are in the inner zone?
docs.answer: The inner zone accounts for 66.9% of all docks — 2,460 of the 3,677 docks across all stations. The remainder is split between the city centre (under 1 km from O'Connell Bridge) and outer stations.
docs.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN zone = 'inner' THEN capacity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(capacity), 1) AS inner_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN zone = 'inner' THEN capacity ELSE 0 END) AS inner_docks, SUM(capacity) AS total_docks FROM marts.dim_station LIMIT 200

attempts.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN zone = 'inner' THEN capacity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(capacity), 1) AS inner_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN zone = 'inner' THEN capacity ELSE 0 END) AS inner_docks, SUM(capacity) AS total_docks FROM marts.dim_station LIMIT 200
